אלהינו ואלהי אבותינו
אֱנוֹשׁ עַד־דַּכָּא תָּשֵׁב · לִפְנֵי גְבָעוֹת וְתֵבֵל תִּישֵׁב׃ בְּהֵאָמֵן אֶצְלְךָ שַׁעֲשׁוּעֵי יוֹמִים · מְרַחֶפֶת עַל־פְּנֵי הַמָּיִם׃ גִּיחוֹת בְּהָבָב מְדִינָה מְשַׁבֶּשֶׁת · נְתָנָה לְמַרְפֵּא וּצְרִי הַחֲבוּשֶׁת׃ דַּעַת טַעַם הַיְּחִידָה מֵהַשְׁחִית · שֵׁרְגוֹ בְּרִינוֹ מַחֲצִית הֵפִית׃ הַמַּצָּע־בִּלְבֵּל עֶלְיוֹן תָּבַע · עֶרְכּוֹ בְּשַׂקּוֹ וְתַעֲנִיתוֹ קָבַע׃ וְאַף כִּי מִבְּכוֹרָה נִגְרַשׁ · פֵּרֵשׁ מֵאָבִיו וּלְהָשִׁיבוֹ דָרַשׁ׃ זְבָד־לוֹ מַשְׂכֹּרֶת יְתֵרָה · יָצְאָה לְהַעֲמִיד בְּאֵר הַתּוֹרָה׃ חַיוּת הַשְּׁבָטִים בְּצִדְקוֹ הֻדְבָּרוּ · קָלוּט בְּזָהָב מֵעוֹת הַמִּדְבָּר׃ טָם בְּנוֹ בָּקִי וּמְיֻשָּׁב · רָאוּי לְהַשִּׂיא עֵצָה וּמֻחְשָׁב׃ יִשְׂרָאֵל קוֹנָהּ יִכְמְרוּ נִיחוּמוֹ׃ שׁוּבָה עַד שֶׁהוּא בְּמִפַּת רַחֲמָיו · כָּתַב לְמַעֲלָה לְהוֹהִיר

en.text:
Our God, and the God of our fathers.
Thou taughtest man repentance even before the hills were formed, and the earth was made habitable; when the Law was still concealed with thee, and the spirit moved upon the face of the waters. When the foe seeketh to devastate the land, repentance saveth the distressed inhabitant. It saved Adam from perdition, when he tasted the forbidden fruit; and it mitigated Cain’s punishment. Reuben, who had defiled his father’s couch, humbled himself by putting on sackcloth and by fasting. And though he forfeited his birth-right yet for having endeavoured to restore Joseph to his father, he received a handsome reward. For, from him was descended Hosea, whose father Beeri was extolled as the source of the Law, by whose virtues the tribes were brought out of the desert to the promised land, even as vile ore is sought for the gold it contains, and whose noble minded son, learned and worthy, was selected to counsel and teach repentance, saying, “Israel, thy Creator is compassionate, return to him while his mercy prevaileth.” On the other hand he threatened refractory Samaria with destruction. Wise pro
i. e., when the evil inclination threatens to destroy the body, repentance saves the distressed soul.

he.text: חֲבַרְתָּהּ · תֶּאְשַׁם שׁוֹמְרוֹן כִּי־מָרָתָה׃ אֶל־נְתִיבוֹת עוֹלָם אוּלי · לְחָכְמָה וּלְנְבִיאָה וְלַתּוֹרָה שָׁאֲלוּ׃ בְּטוֹב וְיָשָׁר לְמֶלֶךְ־נִזְהָרוּ · מִתּוֹךְ־סוֹדוֹ חֲסָדָיו נִכָּרוּ׃ גְּדָל־חֶסֶד לוֹ נְיַחֵל נֵאוֹת מִבְּרִיוֹתָיו וְעֶלְבּוֹנֵנוּ מוֹחֵל׃ דּוֹרוֹנוֹ בִּכְלִי־שָׁבוּר מוּבָל · סַמֵּי־קְצִיעוֹתָיו בְּרָנְנֵנוּ מְקַבֵּל׃ הוּא שֶׁהַנָּבִיא־מִכֶּכֶם מַהֲלָתוֹ · עוֹבֵר עַל־פֶּשַׁע שְׁיָרֵי נַחֲלָתוֹ׃ וּמִי כָמוֹהוּ מוֹרֶה לַחֲטָאִים · פָּשַׁר דְּבָרִים וְרִצּוּי מִבְטָאִים׃ זָרִים תַּחֲלוּשׁוֹתָיו תּוֹסָפוֹת · צְרִירוֹת רָעוֹת בְּמָעוֹת יָפוֹת׃ חוֹטֵא לָשׁוּב אִם יִתְאַפֵּשׁ · קְרִיאוֹת עִתּוֹתָיו בְּעוֹד־רֵישׁ׃ טוֹבָה בִּשְׁבִילוֹ לְעוֹלָם נִהְרָאֵת · רַבִּים־וְיָחִיד זְכוּת נִמְצֵאת׃ יַעַן כִּי נִזְהָרָה פַּעֲמַיִם שׁוּבוּ שׁוּבוּ לַאֲבִיכֶם שֶׁבַּשָּׁמַיִם׃ כְּבֵן מְלָכִים שֶׁיָּצָא לְתַרְבּוּת תּוֹחַלְתּוֹ · חוֹזֵר לְאָבִיו בִּקְרִיבוּת׃ יִשְׂרָאֵל בְּנֶךָ יְקִירְךָ בְּכוֹרְךָ · צַעֲצוּעֵי שַׁעֲשׁוּעֶיךָ זְכוֹר בּוֹרְךָ׃ חוֹזֵר אֶצְלְךָ בִּתְשׁוּבָה שָׁב · קְטֹרֶת הָכוֹן פְּלִילוֹ יֻקְשָׁב׃ הֲמוֹן מֵעֶיךָ יֶהֱמוּ לוֹ · קִדֵּם בְּסִינַי הַשְׁלִים לְמוּלוֹ׃ טוּבְךָ וְרַחֲמֶיךָ הֻכְפַּל לוֹ · נוֹעַם־דְּרָכֶיךָ בִּפְלִילוֹ׃ יַעַן הַיְּחִידָה בְּמַחַט פָּתְחָה · יַד־שֶׁלְךָ כְאוּלָם הֲפָתְחָה׃ אָוֶן רָאוֹתְךָ בַּל תִּתְבּוֹנֵן · יְדַע מְתֵי שָׁוְא לְבוֹנֵן׃ יֵשׁ בְּנוֹהַג עוֹלָם כְּרַבִּים · מְבַזֶּה אֶת־חֲבֵירוֹ בָּרַבִּים׃ וְאַחַר־זְמַן רוּחוֹ בְּצַנְּנוֹ · שִׁחֲר־מִמֶּנּוּ יְבַקֵּשׁ רְצוֹנוֹ׃ נוֹתֵן חוֹב־הַדִּין כְּבַתְּחִלָּה · יָשׁוּב יְבַקֵּשׁ מִמֶּנּוּ מְחִילָה׃ יִגְדַּל וְיִשְׂגַּב כֹּחַ־הַבּוֹרֵא · בִּתְשׁוּבָה מוֹרֶה בְּהַצְנֵעַ קוֹרֵא׃ וְרָאוּי הַשֵּׁם־הַנִּכְבָּד לְקַלְּסוֹ ·

en.text: phets, and even the holy Law, have been consulted as to the way by which sinners may return. The highest authorities have been appealed to. But the gracious King himself teacheth what is right and good. His mercy may be learnt from his own mouth. Let us therefore trust in Him who is of great mercy, and let us hope he will be prevailed on by his creatures, and pardon offences; that he willingly accepteth gifts in broken vessels, for the words of supplicants are as incense to him. That is what the prophet praiseth when he sayeth, “He pardoneth the sin of the remnant of his inheritance; who like him, teacheth sinners how to reform, is like him, propitiated by words?”—Like one who, exchanging bad money for good, hath to give the banker a premium, the penitent, by an increase of virtues and rigid abstinence, hath to make amends for his former sins, has to occupy himself with the holy Law, all the days of his life, and must not be ashamed of his repentance, for by virtue of that he may save the whole world. Two prophets have in different expressions exhorted to repentance. “Turn, and return ye,” to your Father in heaven. The heavenly Father is easily reconciled, even as a king’s son who hath offended, easily reconcileth his father. O remember thou Israel, thy precious son, thy firstborn, thy favourite child, when he returneth to thee with sincere repentance. May his prayer be accepted as incense. O have pity on the people who displayed their readiness at the foot of Sinai, and whom thou hast repeatedly promised thy kindness and compassion, and taught how to pray in an acceptable manner; so that if they but open their hearts as wide as the ear of a needle, thine shall open to them as wide as a hall. Though therefore thou seest their iniquity, regard it not, and ascribe it to delusion. In the ordinary course of things it is the custom, that if any one offendeth his neighbour publicly, and having cooled down, trieth to appease him, he hath to ask his pardon in public. But the power of the Creator is great; he teacheth us to repent in humble silence. Therefore it behoveth us to praise his honoured name, and to appease him with pleasing words, until his spirit be poured on
i. e., that he accepts contrite hearts.
By setting others an example for imitation.
Hosea uses the singular שובה, and Zechariah i. 2 the plural, so as to exhort the individual as well as the community at large.
By saying: “We will do and obey.”
